caption: The drawing is rendered in black ink on a beige or off-white background and features two articles of clothing depicted with fine, clean lines. On the left, there is a back view of a jacket with long sleeves, slightly extending below the waist. Both the hem of the jacket and the end of the sleeve have a deco­rative pattern consisting of vertical lines and curved arches with dots above them. Attached to the jacket are a pair of shorts, also seen from the back, with a vertical row of rectangular embellishments running along the side seam of one leg. On the right side of the image, there is a separate drawing of another pair of shorts viewed from the back and slightly from the side. This garment features a buttoned flap and a vertical row of rectangular designs or fastenings along one side, similar in style to the embellishments shown on the previous pair of shorts. The drawing does not include any shading or color aside from the black outline and beige background, and the composition is centered with ample empty space around the clothing items.
title: Boy's Suit
